name: Richard L. Hanna
summary: Richard Louis Hanna (January 25, 1951 – March 15, 2020) was an American politician who served as a U.S. representative from New York from 2011 to 2017. A member of the Republican Party, his district was numbered the 24th during his first term in Congress; from 2013 to 2017, it was numbered as the 22nd district.
